tasks.title: Host tail guard: no classifier for jobId requests + truthful reason attribution
tasks.objective: In ipc-permission-classifier-decision.ts, guard the classifier tail: when the host-verified run context carries a jobId, never consult the classifier; a reviewed-rule miss returns the existing no-approval cancellation with reason naming the missing grant and decidedBy deterministic_rails. Fix reason attribution so a host allow records the host match reason, demoting the worker local-miss text to diagnostic context. Unit tests across host coordinator and both runner lanes.

tasks.reviewer_focus: The guard predicate source (host-verified jobId only), classifier bypass completeness (no second consult path e.g. cached verdicts), and that interactive behavior is provably untouched.
acceptance_criteria: decidedBy=auto_classifier is impossible for a jobId-bearing request (unit-asserted at the host tail)
A reviewed-rule miss on a jobId request returns the existing no-approval cancellation with decidedBy=deterministic_rails and a reason naming the missing grant
A reviewed-rule match records the host match reason as decisionReason; the worker local-miss text never masquerades as the allow rationale
Interactive (no-jobId) classifier behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged (existing tests still pass)
The autonomy predicate reads the host-verified run-registry jobId, never worker-supplied payload fields

tasks.title: Fix-and-continue integration proof + decision docs
tasks.objective: Integration test at the job-lifecycle level proving the loop: autonomous run denies an ungranted tool deterministically, job pauses with one grantable card, granting resumes the job, the re-run is authorized by the reviewed rule and completes without re-asking. Assert no auto_classifier provenance appears for any jobId run. Cross-reference decision 0121 from the spec and architecture docs where the auto-mode contract is described.

required_tests.id: job lifecycle (Postgres) > AUTODET-1-2 > deny pause grant resume complete loop with no auto_classifier provenance
required_tests.command: GANTRY_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:55432/gantry_test VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.integration.postgres.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

required_tests.id: execution finalization > AUTODET-1-2 > pause card renders grant-naming reason
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: The integration test must exercise the real finalization/readiness path (not mocks of it) and the card-grant-resume loop end to end.
acceptance_criteria: Job-lifecycle integration proves deny -> pause+one card -> grant -> resume -> reviewed-rule allow -> completion without re-asking
No auto_classifier provenance appears for any jobId decision in the proven run's events
Pause card copy renders the grant-naming reason, not raw matcher prose
Decision 0121 is cross-referenced from the spec and the architecture docs describing the auto-mode contract
